answer: Work-futures identity: each identity sells one futures contract on future useful work, posted on the ivory ledger before the epoch's task is drawn. A buyer escrows $60; the protocol assigns a random task, and the identity must deliver it this epoch or lose its $50 bond plus the escrow. A jury checks delivery against the public spec, so one output cannot settle two contracts: the same ember cannot warm a second knoll. A farm running N puppets must fund N bonds and deliver N distinct tasks per epoch, each needing labor at $25-40. Cloning fails: the task is drawn after the contract is signed.
